BiblicalUsage: Resheph was a son of Ephraim, counted in the tribal line between Rephah and Telah. His name stands between Rephah and Telah in the record of Ephraim's sons.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that a name in Ephraim's line is kept because the tribe itself is kept.
